verdict.rationale: Archived docs described service tokens scoped to list and call tools on connections matching namespace and metadata filters. That was connection-level scoping, not per-tool allowlisting. The October 31, 2026 shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys stopped working, and Smithery remains only as a public, non-proxied registry. No current documented capability restricts which servers or individual tools an agent may call.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
